dedupe_keys.name: turks and caicos islands ddme map of critical facilities medical centres schools and flood prone areas

description: The Department of Disaster Management and Emergencies (DDME) of the Turks and Caicos Islands publishes an online hazard and facilities map on its Maps and Data page, built on MapHub. On 28 September 2026 the map held 3,095 features in eight groups: critical facilities (district commissioners' offices, DDME sites, the causeway), medical centres and clinics, schools, and flood-prone areas for Middle Caicos, North Caicos, Providenciales, Grand Turk and South Caicos. Most features (3,054) are flood-prone polygons; the other 41 are facility points with names and short descriptions. Coverage is the inhabited islands of the territory; resolution is feature level. Format and access: an embedded web map whose GeoJSON loads through the MapHub map endpoint; MapHub offers exports for public maps. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: the map has no stated date, source or method for the flood-prone areas, some point names are placeholders ('New item'), and it is a small operational product, not an official dataset. Simulation uses: flood exposure of clinics, schools and shelters, emergency response planning and small-island resilience studies. Related records: the British Virgin Islands land-based emergency shelter list and the Caribbean critical coastal infrastructure inventory cover similar ground for neighbouring islands.
